// 05 - Operational Platform

Clinic Management System

A multi-role, operations-first backend platform used by front-desk reception, clinic administration, and treatment teams to keep intake, assessments, package sessions, bookings, and staff presence aligned in one controlled workflow.

// care workflow

Registration → Clinical Assessment → Package Assignment → Session Tracking → Appointment Validation → Staff Attendance

Patient Intake to Evaluation: Every patient starts with registration and a structured clinical check, then treatment packages are assigned on top of that assessment so care decisions stay tied to a reliable record.

Package Ledger & Session Consumption: Sessions are consumed only against active treatment packages, with used and remaining balances always visible, giving the clinic a clear treatment-progress and entitlement view.

Scheduling Rules & Visit Outcomes: Appointments are not just calendar slots; they are validated against clinic operating rules, then recorded as attended, missed, or cancelled to keep booking history accurate and auditable.

Staff Presence & Shift Accountability: Intern doctor attendance is logged per working session, and receptionist shift start/end is captured through a controlled workflow so administration can track day-level staff presence.

How The Day Runs

Front-desk, treatment staff, and administration share one timeline, giving a clear day-level view of what is booked, attended, missed, consumed, or still pending.

Administrative Value

By replacing fragmented manual follow-up with one backend source of truth, the clinic runs with cleaner scheduling, faster status checks, and stronger daily operational control.

// operational value

Built as a serious multi-role business system, not a demo CRUD app: it coordinates patient flow, package/session accounting, booking integrity, and staff administration across the full clinic day.
